title: Ghost Hunters
description:
S14 E01 — The Lost Souls of Joliet
Dakota Laden, Tanner Wiseman and Alex Schroeder of "Destination Fear" join TAPS as they take on Old Joliet Prison; unsettling paranormal activity has been ramping up at the now-shuttered penitentiary and volunteers there are desperate for answers.

title: Ghost Hunters
description:
S14 E02 — Lost Bones of the Argo
Satori Hawes and Cody DesBiens join TAPS for an investigation at a Nebraska hotel with a grim and grisly past; with frightening phenomena taking hold of the property, the owners need TAPS' help to determine how safe it is for guests.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S25 E24 — Vengeance in Oxnard
The crew sails into the coastal town of Oxnard, Calif., to help a couple tormented by unseen forces in their house; Zak makes a surprising connection as the team attempts to unmask the driving force behind the negative energy in the stately home.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Lockdown in Lancaster
The crew pierces the seal on California's Mira Loma Detention Center; decades of death, violence and bloodshed have scarred this massive compound, painting a thick layer of doom on every square inch and delivering some of the most solid evidence yet.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Village of Lost Souls
The crew investigates reports of vicious paranormal attacks at LA's Heritage Square Museum; as the team explores this collection of Victorian homes, they suspect a dark portal is responsible for shadow figure sightings and poltergeist activity.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Abandoned in Elko
The crew awaken hostile spirits in Nevada when they investigate the Commercial Hotel and Casino; the building's rough history of lawless cowboys, cutthroat gamblers and exploited women fuels a malevolent energy.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Mentryville Ghost Town
Zak and the crew venture to California's first oil boomtown to investigate reports of ghostly activity inside its buildings and glowing anomalies in the surrounding hills; chaos ensues as the guys attempt to unravel the mystery of Mentryville.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Hotel Barclay
Zak and the crew return to LA's Skid Row district to investigate a nearly abandoned building steeped in a dark, grisly history that rivals the Hotel Cecil; the guys have their hands full as both the dead and the living push back on the investigation.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Terror in Tempe
Zak and the crew are called to Tempe, Ariz., to investigate a brewery awash with dark and disturbing paranormal activity; the team lands in the crosshairs of dueling entities as they dig deep into the colossal factory's troubled past.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:

title: Ghost Adventures
description:

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
Hotel San Carlos
The crew peels back the glamorous façade of a Phoenix, Ariz., hotel to expose a darkness that's said to drive people mad; the team encounters a demonic presence that could be responsible for countless deaths on the property.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
King Gillette Ranch
The crew visits King Gillette Ranch, a sprawling compound built on sacred land; its dark history plus a brush with a cult has birthed violent spirit activity that drains the living of their energy, making this the GAC's heaviest investigation yet.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:

Zak and the crew check in for a night of terror at an Arizona hotel where guests and staff have reported troubling paranormal experiences for decades; the chaotic spirit is wreaking havoc, and the GAC may be the only ones who can help.

title: True Terror With Robert Englund
description:
S01 E03 — Cryptic Messages
Inexplicable phone calls torment the manager of a New Jersey cemetery; a foolhardy citizen taunts an insane serial killer in New Orleans; and love and obsession drive a Florida scientist to desperate lengths.

title: True Terror With Robert Englund
description:
S01 E05 — Spirits in the Air
The horror escalates as a Massachusetts family hunts for a hidden fortune in a haunted house; a farmer battles a devilish curse in Ohio; a greedy mortician faces the wrath of the dead after he defiles their graves in a corrupt scheme.

title: True Terror With Robert Englund
description:
S01 E02 — Fear the Unknown
Two aging ranch hands battle a flying man-eater in the Arizona desert; a young Theodore Roosevelt trespasses into the lair of a half-human predator; and demonic entities prey upon villagers in rural Pennsylvania.

title: True Terror With Robert Englund
description:
S01 E04 — Legends and Lore
An Arizona sheepherder hunts down a mysterious beast that killed his wife; a hairy giant stalks a Missouri farmer and his family; a medicine man battles evil spirits who devour human flesh.

title: True Terror With Robert Englund
description:
S01 E06 — Bad Omens
A man uncovers an unholy secret in Kansas; a factory worker confronts the witch he believes cursed him; a Philadelphia secretary is tormented by nightmares foretelling her death.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E01 — Bottled Spirits
A chef and his wife find the perfect location for their restaurant in a cozy waterfront town, but the spirits haunting the Victorian mansion have other plans; soon, eerie and unexplained events threaten to force the couple out of business.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E02 — Deliverance in Chicago
A couple watch helplessly as dark forces emerge from the shadows and torment their teenage daughters; desperate for help, they reach out to a spiritual warrior to combat the demons haunting their home.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E03 — Daydreams and Nightmares
A woman's dream of opening a costume shop is interrupted when she discovers the building she just bought comes with resident spirits; when the haunting grows dangerous, she calls on a spiritualist minister to help the trapped souls cross over.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E04 — Inner Demons
Childhood sweethearts reconnect, but their happily-ever-after is threatened by dangerous poltergeist activity in their new home; when they find cryptic messages written on the bathroom mirror, the couple reach out to a renowned demonologist.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E05 — Asylum 49
A lifelong haunted house enthusiast purchases an old hospital to build a Halloween attraction; as staff members prepare for the grand opening, they experience a series of paranormal events suggesting that the location really is haunted.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E06 — Return to Bergen House
A woman finds herself in a nightmare when she is forced to return to the home that haunted her childhood; when the spirits get aggressive, paranormal researchers and psychics band together to give her what she's wanted for decades -- answers.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E07 — Nevermore
A couple find themselves under attack by paranormal forces summoned by a jealous ex; as the dark spirits grow more violent, they turn to multiple paranormal experts in an attempt to break the curse by any means before it breaks them up.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E08 — The Devil's Doll
A woman is enchanted by a pair of antique dolls and brings them home; soon after, she is stricken by a mysterious illness that nearly kills her, and her husband is sure the dolls are to blame.

title: A Haunting
description:
S11 E09 — The Man in the Closet
A family awakens a vengeful spirit when they renovate a century-old farmhouse in Massachusetts; after a near-fatal encounter, they bring in a team of paranormal experts to settle the score with the invisible intruder.
